content:
sophia: Heads-up — release cutoff moved up to tomorrow 09:00 PT. We have 3 docs PRs that need reviewer approval and a docs-preview run. Can we coordinate a nightshift plan so nothing blocks the release?

maria: ack. which PRs?

sophia: PR#4523 (sdk snippets), PR#4531 (versioned migration guide), PR#4535 (link fixes).

josh: I can take 4523 tonight after 21:00 PT. Can someone run preview and drop links here once CI finishes? :+1:

kaushik: I can do 4531 but heads up — versioned site build sometimes takes 20-30m. If we cutover at 09:00 PT we need the versioned docs merged by 07:30 PT to let the site builder run and for smoke tests.

maria: noted. I'll queue 4535 (link fixes) first thing in the morning but can also do a quick pass if needed tonight.

sophia: plan proposal: 1) 21:00 PT — josh reviews 4523 and requests changes or approves. 2) 23:00 PT — preview-bot run for approved PRs. 3) 03:00 PT — kaushik merges 4531 so site build starts 03:10 PT and finishes by 03:40 PT. 4) 07:30 PT — final cutover freeze check. Does that work?

josh: I prefer earlier preview run. If preview-bot can do incremental previews we can run it at 22:00 PT once 4523 has an approval.

preview-bot: queued preview for PR#4523, PR#4531. status: pending CI.

ci-bot: CI started for PR#4523 (docs-preview), PR#4531 (site-build). current: PR#4523 tests 18/22 passed.

kaushik: if CI flakes, we should have a rollback plan. Suggest we keep the previous doc release pinned to vX.Y and only switch the version flag after smoke looks good.

maria: rollback plan sounds good. Also suggest we add reviewer fallback: if assigned reviewer is offline, tag @sophia or @maria as secondary. People, please update reviewers on the PRs now.

sophia: done — added @josh as reviewer on 4523, @kaushik on 4531, @maria on 4535. Added a note in PR descriptions: "target merge window: release-cutoff-2409876543; fallback reviewers: sophia,maria"

ci-bot: PR#4523 docs-preview: CI passed ✅ — staging preview: https://preview.internal.redwood/4523. PR#4531 site-build: failing smoke test (link-checker).

josh: I'll take the link-checker error on 4531. Looks like an internal redirect changed. Quick fix in a minute.

josh: fix pushed to 4531 — updated redirect in migration guide. cc @kaushik

ci-bot: PR#4531 site-build: all checks passed ✅.

preview-bot: staging previews updated: 4523 -> https://preview.internal.redwood/4523, 4531 -> https://preview.internal.redwood/4531. Please review page snippets and API sample blocks (esp. SDK code).

maria: reviewed 4535 link fixes — LGTM. Small nit in 4523 SDK example: language tag missing in fenced block. I'll push a tiny fix.

maria: pushed nitfix to 4523 (added ```python tag).

josh: re-approving 4523 after nit. ready to merge when CI green.

ci-bot: PR#4523 CI: green ✅. PR#4535 CI: green ✅.

kaushik: merging 4531 now (versioned migration). Command: `git merge --no-ff origin/4531 && ./scripts/site-build.sh --env=staging`

sophia: :eyes: once the build finishes, let's run the smoke smoke-checklist: link-checker, sample-run, quick search sanity. I can be on call 06:30 PT if anything pops.

preview-bot: site-build triggered by merge 4531. estimated time: 18 minutes.

ci-bot: post-merge smoke: link-checker OK, sample-run OK, search index OK.

sophia: ok we are good to mark docs as ready for cutoff. I'll post to release channel with the docs preview links and merge list. Thanks all for the late help! :tada:

maria: great work everyone. I'll keep an eye during final cutoff.

josh: nice. night shift handoff to @maria for morning watch.

preview-bot: archived previews for merged PRs.

sophia: thread conclusion: merged PRs: 4523, 4531. 4535 scheduled merge at 08:00 PT if no last-minute issues. Fallback reviewers updated.
